title: Recite! The first command and Isaiah’s echo
translation: Recite in the name of your Lord who created, created the human from a clinging clot. Recite! Your Lord is most generous, who taught by the pen, taught humans what they did not know.
body: In **Aisha’s report** (al-Bukhari) these verses come first, and Muhammad answers “I am not a reciter”. **Paul Neuenkirchen** sees the scene as modelled on **Isaiah 40:6**, same root: “Cry!” “What shall I cry?” Isaiah 40:8 became the **Lutheran Reformation’s motto**.
question: Is the “I am not a reciter” scene remembered history, or a story later shaped by Isaiah 40?
reading: Nicolai Sinai, The Qur'an: A Historical-Critical Introduction (2017)
